      @GetMapping("/orders/track/{orderNumber}") public ApiResponse<Map<String,Object>> trackOrder(@PathVariable String orderNumber)
      Public tracking by order number (no login). Response is limited to delivery timeline fields only; totals, line items, and internal ids are omitted. Order numbers are high-entropy (MNM-…).
